senses.gloss: उत्क [utka], a. [उद्-स्वार्थे कन्; उत्कः = उत्कण्ठितः; उत्क उन्मनाः P.V. 2.8. Sk.]
Desirous of, longing for, anxiously wishing for (in comp.); अद्रिसुतासमागमोत्कः Ku.6.95; मानसोत्काः Me.11; sometimes with an inf.; उत्कन्धरं द्रष्टुमवेक्ष्य शौरिम् Śi.4.18.
Regretting, sad, sorrowful.
Absentminded.
त्कः Desire.
Opportunity.
उत्कच [utkaca], a.
Having the hair erect; as in घटोत्कच.
Having no hair.
Full blown; बभ्राज उत्कचकुमुद्गण- वानपीच्यः Bhāg.3.23.38.
उत्कचय् [utkacay], To coil the hair upwards.
उत्कच्छा [utkacchā], A metre of six lines, each line containing eleven syllabic instants.
उत्कञचुक [utkañacuka], a.
Without bodice, or jacket.
Without a coat of mail.
उत्कट [utkaṭa], a. Large, spacious; ज्याजिह्वया वलयितोत्कटकोटि- दंष्ट्रम् U.4.29.
Powerful, mighty, extraordinary, fierce; अत्युत्कटे च रौद्रे च शत्रौ यस्य न हीयते Pt.1.13; Mv. 1.39,5.33.
Excessive, much; अत्युत्कटैः पापपुण्यैरिहैव फलमश्नुते H.1.85.
Prominently visible, conspicuous; ˚लाञ्छनस्य U.35.
Abounding in, richly endowed with; पादपान् कुसुमोत्कटान् Rām.
Drunk, mad, furious; मदोत्कटः.
Superior, high.
Proud, haughty.
Uneven.
Difficult.
टः A fluid (ichor) dropping from the temples of an etephant in rut.
An elephant in rut.
The plant Saccharum Sara (इक्षुतृण).
Pride, intoxication. -टाः The plant Laurus Cassia (सैहीलता; Mar. उट्कटारी, सिंहपिंपळी). -टम् The fragrant bark of Laurus Cassia (Mar. दालचिनी).
उत्कटिका [utkaṭikā] उत्कटुकासनम् [utkaṭukāsanam], उत्कटुकासनम् Sitting on the hams, squatting, the manner of sitting of Yogis (the legs being outstretched and forming a right angle).
उत्कट् [utkaṭ], 1 P. To start or burst out; टङ्कारोत्कटमुच्चरन्ति नलकाः Mv.5.33.
उत्कणिका [utkaṇikā], 1 A raised particle.
Desire, longing; Mārk. P. (v. l. for उत्कलिका).
उत्कण्ठ [utkaṇṭha], a. [उन्नतः कण्ठो यस्य]
Having the neck uplifted, ready, on the point of (doing anything), in comp.; आज्ञावचनोत्कण्ठः Ś.2; रथस्वनोत्कण्ठमृगे वाल्मीकीये तपोवने R.15.11.
(Hence) Anxious, eager. -ण्ठः, -ण्ठा A mode of sexual enjoyment.
उत्कण्ठा [utkaṇṭhā], 1 Anxiety, uneasiness (in general); यास्यत्यद्य शकुन्तलेति हृदयं संस्पृष्टमुत्कण्ठया Ś4.5; अवाप्त˚ Māl.2.12. seized with fright, suddenly startled.
Longing for a beloved person or thing; दृष्टिरधिकं सोत्कण्ठ मुद्वीक्षते Amaru.28.
Regret, sorrow, missing any thing or person; गाढोत्कण्ठा Māl.1.15; Me.85.
उत्कण्ठते [utkaṇṭhatē], Den. Ā.
To be anxious, pine or be sorry for; Ś.4; Śi.9.54.

To yearn, be eagerly desirous of (with gen. or dat.); स्वर्गाय नोत्कण्ठते V.3,4; Mv.6; उत्कण्ठते च युष्मत्सन्निकर्षस्य U.6; 6.21; Māl.4; Bk.5.75.-Caus. (उत्कण्ठयति) To create anxiety or longing, inspire with tender emotions; Bh.1.35; Ghaṭ.5.
उत्कण्ठित [utkaṇṭhita], p. p.
Anxious, uneasy.
Regretting, grieving for, sorrowful.

Longing for a beloved person or thing. -ता A mistress longing for her absent lover or husband, one of the eight heroines; she is thus defined -आगन्तुं कृतचित्तो$पि दैवान्नायाति यत्प्रियः । तदनागमदुःखार्ता विरहोत्कण्ठिता तु सा ॥ S. D.121. उत्कण्ठितासि तरले, न हि न हि सीख पिच्छिलः पन्थाः ।
उत्कता [utkatā], 1 A state of longing or regret, anxiety.
N. of a plant having aromatic seeds (गजपिप्पली).
उत्कन्धर [utkandhara], a. [उन्नतः कन्धरो$स्य] Having the neck uplifted; उत्कन्धरं दारुकमित्युवाच Śi.4.18. -रम् Bending back the neck.

उत्कम्प [utkampa], a. Trembling; इमां हरिणशावाक्षीं त्रासोत्कम्पपयो- धराम् Rā.5.24.37. श्वास˚ कुचम् Amaru.9. -म्पः, - म्पनम् Trembling, tremor, agitation; किमधिकत्रासोत्कम्प दिशः समुदीक्षसे Amaru.31; Me.72.
उत्कम्पिन् [utkampin], 1 Trembling.
Agitating.
उत्कम्प् [utkamp], 1 Ā. To tremble, quiver, shake. -Caus. To cause to tremble, shake, agitate.
उत्कयति [utkayati], Den. P. To make uneasy; मनस्विनीरुत्कयितुं पटीयसा Śi.1.59.
उत्कर [utkara], a. (-रा, -री f.) [कॄ-अप्] That which piles or throws up or raises.
रः A heap, multitude; नखांशूत्करः Ki.8.5.
A pile, stack.
Rubbish, what is thrown up (मूषिकोत्कर) Mk.3.
A bunch (as of flowers); पादपान्कुसुमोत्करान् Rām.2.55.3.; Bhāg.7.1.69.
उत्करः [utkarḥ], See under उत्कॄ.
उत्कारः [utkārḥ], [कॄ-घञ् कॄ धान्ये P.III.3.3]
Winnowing corn.
Piling up corn. उत्कारेण धान्यानामनभीष्टपरिग्रहाः Bk.
One who sows corn.
उत्करिका [utkarikā], A sort of sweetmeat made with milk, treacle, and ghee.
उत्कारिका [utkārikā], [कॄ-ण्वुल्] Poultice.
उत्करीय [utkarīya], a. Belonging to a heap.
उत्कर्करः [utkarkarḥ], A kind of musical instrument.
उत्कर्ण [utkarṇa], a. Having the ears erect. -र्णः An erect ear.
उत्कर्तनम् [utkartanam], 1 Cutting off, tearing out, cutting to pieces.
Rooting out, eradication.
उत्कर्ष [utkarṣa], a.
Superior, eminent.
Much, abundant
Exaggerated, boastful.
Attractive.
र्षः Pulling off or upwards, drawing or pulling up; चरणोत्कर्षै- र्दारयन्निव मेदिनीम् Rām.3.56.29.
Elevation, eminence, rise, prosperity; निनीषुः कुलमुत्कर्षम् Ms.4.244,9.24.
Increase, abundance, excess; पञ्चानामपि भूतानामुत्कर्षं पुपुषुर्गुणाः R.4.11.
Excellence, highest merit, glory; उत्कर्षः स च धन्विनां यदिषवः सिध्यन्ति लक्ष्ये चले Ś.2.5.
Selfconceit, boasting.
Joy, pleasure.

Postponement (of some detail or details at a विकृतियाग) i. e. performing them at a later stage; तदादि उत्कर्षे तदन्तमपकर्षे स्यात् ŚB. on MS.5.1.24. -Comp. -समः A kind of fallacy attributing similar qualities to two objects because they have one quality in common; e. g. affirming that a sound has a shape like a jar because both are perishable.
उत्कर्षक [utkarṣaka], a. Drawing upwards, raising, elevating, increasing &c.
उत्कर्षणम् [utkarṣaṇam], 1 Drawing upwards.
Taking or pulling off. -णी N. of a Śakti.
उत्कर्षिन् [utkarṣin], a. Drawing or pulling up.
उत्कल [utkala], a. Excessive, piteous; K.36.
लः N. of a country, the modern Orissa, or the inhabitants of that country (pl.); जगन्नाथप्रान्तदेश उत्कलः परिकीर्तितः; see ओड्र; उत्कलादर्शितपथः R.4.38.
A fowler, bird-catcher.
A porter (carrying a load with him).
A subdivision of Brāhmaṇas.
उत्कलाप [utkalāpa], a. Having the tail erect and expanded; तीरस्थलीबर्हिभिरुत्कलापैः प्रस्निग्धकेकैरभिनन्द्यमानम् R.16.64.
उत्कलापयति [utkalāpayati], Den. P.
To ask (one) permission to go, take leave of; Pt.5.
To cause the peacock to spread its plumage.
To cause (one) to be proud, produce conceit by an acknowledgment of merit.
To bring one's wife home from her father's house; to marry; Ved.
उत्कलिका [utkalikā], 1 Anxiety in general, uneasiness; जाता नोत्कलिका Amaru.84; K.138,25,21,234; Dk.17.2.
Longing for, regretting, missing anything or person.
Wanton sport, dalliance (हेला).
A bud.

A wave; वनावलीरुत्कलिकासहस्र˚ Śi.3.7; क्षुभितमुत्कलिका- तरलं मनः ruffled by waves. Māl.3.1 (where उत्कलिका also means anxiety); K.161; cf. also जलयन्त्रजलाकार- कीलालोत्कलिकाकुलाः Śiva. B.14.33. -Comp. -प्रायम् a variety of prose-composition abounding in compound words and hard letters; भवेदुत्कलिकाप्रायं समासाढ्यं दृढाक्षरम् Chand. M.6.
उत्कलित [utkalita], a. Unbound, loosened; स तस्य हस्तोत्कलितस्तदा$- सुरः Bhāg.7.8.26.
Regretting, sorry for.
Opened, blossomed (as flowers); प्रहर्षवेगोत्कलितेक्षणाननाः Bhāg. 1.43.2.
Rising, prosperous; पास्यन्त्यपाङ्गोत्कलितस्मि- तासवम् Bhāg.1.39.23.
उत्कषणम् [utkaṣaṇam], 1 Tearing, pulling up.
Ploughing, drawing through (as a plough); सद्यः सीरोत्कषणसुरभि क्षेत्रमारुह्य मालम् Me.16.
उत्काका [utkākā], A cow calving every year.
उत्कायते [utkāyatē], Den. Ā. To long for.
उत्काशनम् [utkāśanam], Ordering, commanding.
उत्कासः [utkāsḥ] सनम् [sanam] उत्कासिका [utkāsikā], सनम् उत्कासिका Hemming, clearing the throat of muscus.
उत्किर [utkira], a. [कॄ-कर्तरि श] Carrying or bearing away, wafting, scattering upwards (at the end of comp.); पुष्परेणूत्किरैः R.1.38; निनाय सात्यन्तहिमोत्किरानिलाः Ku. 5.26;6.5.
उत्कीर्ण [utkīrṇa], p. p.
Thrown or piled up, scattered.
Engraven, carved, sculptured; Māl.5.1; K.17, 36,79,16,129,133,141,186,26; ˚नामधेयम् engraven with a name.
Bored, perforated; घुण˚ Pt.3.139.
उत्कीर्तनम् [utkīrtanam], 1 Crying out, proclaiming.
Praising, celebrating, extolling; S. D.495.
उत्कीर्तित [utkīrtita], p. p.
Proclaimed, promulgated.
Praised, celebrated, renowned.
उत्कीलित [utkīlita], a Nailed up.
उत्कुञ्चिता [utkuñcitā] का [kā], का The plant Nigella Indica (Mar. कोळिंजन).
उत्कुटक [utkuṭaka], a. Stretched on the back with the face upwards. -Comp. -आसनम् a posture with the face upwards.
उत्कुटम् [utkuṭam], [उन्नतः कुटो यत्र] Lying down or sleeping with the face (or head) upwards, stretching out on the back.
उत्कुणः [utkuṇḥ], 1 A bug.
A louse.
उत्कुल [utkula], a. [उत्क्रान्तः कुलात्] Fallen from the family, disgracing or dishonouring one's family; यदि यथा वदति क्षितिपस्तथा । त्वमसि किं पितुरुत्कुलया त्वया ॥ Ś.5.27.
उत्कूल [utkūla], a. [उत्क्रान्तः कूलात्]
Going up-hill (as rivers) (Ved.).
Reaching the bank.
Overflowing the bank; K.33. -लम् into up-hill; Av.19.25.1. -Comp. -निकूल a. going up and down.
उत्कूजः [utkūjḥ], The singing (of the cuckoo).
उत्कूटः [utkūṭḥ], [उन्नतं कूटमस्य] A parasol or umbrella.
उत्कूर्चक [utkūrcaka], a. With a कूर्च in hand; Hch.4.
उत्कूर्दनम् [utkūrdanam], Jumping up, springing upwards; ˚शक्ति- र्नास्ति Pt.2.
उत्कूलित [utkūlita], a. Brought to the bank or shore, reaching the bank; प्रतिक्षणोत्कूलितशैवलाभाः Śi.3.7.
उत्कृ [utkṛ], 8 Ā. To inform against.
उत्कॄ [utk]ॄ, 6 U.
To scatter, upwards, throw up, pile up or heap; रजोभिस्तुरगोत्कीर्णैः R.1.42.
To dig up, excavate.
To engrave, carve, sculpture; उत्कीर्णा इव वासयष्टिषु निशानिद्रालसा बर्हिणः V.3.2; R.4.59; see उत्कीर्ण also.
उत्कृतिः [utkṛtiḥ], f. N. of a class of metres having 14 syllables.
उत्कृत् [utkṛt], 6 P.
To cut out or off, 'tear out or off; तस्मिन् रामशरोत्कृत्ते बले R.12.49; Ms.11.14; Y.3.259.
To cut to pieces, cut up, hack, butcher; उत्कृत्योत्कृत्य कृत्तिम् Māl.5.16.
उत्कॄत् [utk]ॄ[t], 1 P. To proclaim, celebrate, praise, extol; महिमानं यदुत्कीर्त्य R.1.32.
उत्कृष् [utkṛṣ], 1 P.
To draw or pull up, raise or lift up; उदकर्षि Śi.13.6; to draw or take out, extract, extricate; अङ्गदकोटिलग्नं प्रालम्बमुत्कृष्य R.6.14.
To draw, attract; Śi.17.42.
To pull or put off.
To increase, enhance (opp. अपकृष्.).
To bend (as a bow).
To tear asunder. -Caus. To elevate, raise, increase.-pass.
To be lifted, raised.
To raise, be supreme or eminent.
उत्कृष्ट [utkṛṣṭa], p. p.
Drawn up or out, raised, elevated; दस्यूत्कृष्टा जनपदाः Bhāg.12.3.32.
Extracted.
Excellent, eminent, superior, best, highest; Ms.5.163, 7.126,8.281; बल˚ Pt.3.36 superior in strength; so ज्ञान˚ गुण˚, &c.
Much, excessive, very great, increased; जिह्वालौल्य˚ Pt.1.
Tilled; ploughed.
Scratched; ऐरावतविषाणाग्रैरुत्कृष्टकिणवक्षसम् Rām.6.4.5.
Plucked, cut out,; उत्कृष्टपर्णकमला Rām.5.19.15 ('उत्कृष्टानि त्रुटितानि पर्णानि यस्याः सा' इति टीका).
Attracted; Mb.14.59.1. -Comp. -उपाधिता state of high illusion-भूमः a good soil. -वेदनम् marrying a man of a higher caste; वसनस्य दशा ग्राह्या शूद्रयोत्कृष्टवेदने Ms.3.44.
उत्कृष्टता [utkṛṣṭatā] त्वम् [tvam], त्वम् Excellence, eminence; greatness.
उत्कोचः [utkōcḥ], [उत्कुच्-अञ्]

A bribe (lit. bending one from the right path); Śukra.1.297; उत्कोचमिव ददती K.232; Dk.155; उत्कोचजीविनो द्रव्यहीनान् कृत्वा विवासयेत् Y.1. 339. संगम्योत्कोचदानादि दत्त्वा सैन्यं प्रयाच्यताम् Parṇāl.5.44.
Receiving a bribe; उत्कोचैर्वञ्चनाभिश्च कार्याण्यनुविहन्ति च Mb.12.56.51.
Penalty, tribute; Hch.4. (Gīrvāṇa.)
उत्कोचक [utkōcaka], a. Bribed.
कः A bribe.
The receiver of a bribe; Ms.9.258.
उत्कोचिन् [utkōcin], To be bribed, corruptible. उत्कोचिनां मृषो- क्तीनांवञ्चकानां च या गतिः Mb.7.73.32.
उत्कोटि [utkōṭi], a. Pointed.
उत्कोठः [utkōṭhḥ], A Kind of leprosy. Bhāva. P.
उत्क्रमः [utkramḥ], 1 Going up or out, departure.
Progressive increase.
Going astray, deviation, transgression, violation. -Comp. -ज्या (in Geometry) The versed sine; Sūrya.
उत्क्रामः [utkrāmḥ], 1 Going out or up, departure.
Surpassing, excelling.
Violation, transgression.
Opposition, contrariety.
उत्क्रमणम् [utkramaṇam], 1 Going up or out, departure.
Ascent, soaring aloft.
Surpassing, exceeding.
The flight or passage of the soul (out of the body), i. e. death (= प्राणोत्क्रमणम्) देहादुत्क्रमणं चास्मात्पुनर्गर्भे च संभवम् Ms.6.63; विष्वङ्ङ्न्या उत्क्रमणे भवन्ति Kaṭh.2.6.16; Ch. Up.8.6.6.
उत्क्रमणीय [utkramaṇīya], pot. p. To be transgressed, to be given up or abandoned.
उत्क्रम् [utkram], 1 U., 4 P.
To go up, step up, ascend; उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितं वापि Bg.15.1.
To step beyond; उत्क्रान्तशैशवौ R.15.33; past childhood.
To step out, go out or away, depart; ऊर्ध्वं प्राणा ह्युत्क्रामन्ति Ms.2.12; Mv.1.
To pass away, die; यच्चाप्युत्क्रामतीश्वरः Bg.15.8.
To go or pass over, omit.
To disregard, not to notice, neglect; आर्ष प्रमाणमुत्क्रम्य, धर्ममुत्क्रम्य Mb.
To transgress, violate; उत्क्रान्तसीमा Dk.11,97.-Caus. (क्रामयति) To cause to go up or ascend.
उत्क्रान्त [utkrānta], p. p.
Gone forth or out, departed; उत्क्रान्तमिवासुभिः K.33; R.7.53.
Faded, effaced (as colour); उत्क्रान्तवर्णक्रमधूसराणाम् R.16.17.
Gone over or beyond, passed, surpassed.
Dead.
Trespassing, exceeding, surpassing (actively used).
उत्क्रान्ति [utkrānti], f.
Going up or out, departure. योगधारणयो- त्क्रान्तिः संवादो नारदाजयोः Bhāg.12.12.7.
The flight or passage of the soul (out of the body), death; उत्क्रान्तिगत्यागतीनाम् Br. Sūtra.2.3.19. -Comp. -धेनुः A cow gifted at the time of one's death.
उत्क्रान्तिन् [utkrāntin], a. passing away, gone, departed.
उत्क्रुश् [utkruś], 1 P.
To cry out, exclaim, cry aloud.
To call out to; उदक्रोशत् स पाण्डवान् Mb.
To proclaim.
उत्क्रुष्ट [utkruṣṭa], p. p. Crying out, exclaiming.
